risk_note: RV2 by PR (platform/events and platform/queue; notification RV1). notification consumes appeal.resolved (EVENT_SUBSCRIPTIONS entry, evt.notification-appeal-result queue, worker concurrency 5, wired on the worker entry only) and writes the BR-TEXT-23 APPEAL_RESULT inbox message: account_revoked / order_revoked / upheld by status and target_type; blocked_request sends nothing and writes no log (BR-ID-36). Body defaults are BR-TEXT-23 verbatim, title inbox.title.APPEAL_RESULT, notify_templates overrides by variant; when an account appeal revokes and the payload carries need_reauth=true the existing NEED_REAUTH_TEXT sentence (shared with RISK_STATE_CHANGED unbanned, now exported, not copied) is appended, so a revoked ban yields one message only (orchestrator ruling D10-141 ③). notify_logs (dedupe_key appeal.resolved:<event_id>) and inbox_messages are written in one transaction; redelivery leaves one message and one log. Inbox only, category service, no push or SMS. The event has no publisher on main yet (the appeal closing service is assigned to the identity lane, D10-141 ②); this task is the consumer only, tested by publishing the event directly. The two platform contract tests add only this subscription, queue and worker (ledger test_paths; class 1, label checked by the orchestrator under approvals #24); no assertion changes. No money, no attribution.
